hypothesis: After v5 showed the original N1 W2 component was inadequate, test a separately versioned PRE-only conditional component whose fixed coefficients are aligned to the explicit W2 simulator specification and whose latent-skill estimate is the analytically preregistered Gaussian posterior mean from observed score.
input_dataset: Digital Twin v1 synthetic W2 only; seeds 20260922 and 20260923, 500 standard 7-rider races per seed. No real/historical input.
prediction_method: N2_SPEC_ALIGNED_POSTERIOR_CONDITIONAL; PRE-only observed score shrinkage 0.7677543186180422 plus fixed simulator-spec class/style/wind/bank/line and conditional-relation coefficients; latent skill, oracle, hidden alpha and outcomes excluded from prediction inputs.
conclusion: PASS for the preregistered synthetic component-adequacy gate. N2 reduced W2 KL by roughly 24-26% versus N1 and 25-27% versus C0 on both disjoint seeds, with every sufficiently populated PRE-signal stratum improving by at least 19%. This supports using frozen N2, rather than N1, as the W2-side component in a new separately preregistered synthetic adaptive-mixture experiment.
claim_boundary: Synthetic engineering/falsification only. No real Keirin predictive, economics, ROI, promotion, live or production claim.
follow_up: Preregister a new synthetic learnable-regime adaptive-mixture experiment using C0 and frozen N2 on new disjoint design/evaluation seeds; keep v4 evaluation seed untouched and all real/economics scopes closed.
